before: We read that as showing that the judge could keep invented sources out of the file and could penalise length, both of which it did throughout, but that it could not separate a good claim from a weak one anywhere in the middle of the range, and that the ranking in this system was in practice being done by the reviewer.
after: This suggests that the scalar score did not reliably distinguish the reviewer's stronger and weaker categories in this sample. The mechanical gate checked quotation presence and the scorer imposed the length penalty; neither was an accomplishment of the model judge. The reviewer became an important ranking mechanism, but agreement with its verdicts is not an independent measure of research quality.
